1: # Requirements: Treads
2: 
3: **Defined:** 8 October 2026  
4: **Core Value:** Get from launch to first organism capture in two taps, delivering fast, honest, Wikipedia-grounded identification that stays entirely private on the user's phone.
5: 
6: ---
7: 
8: ## v1 Requirements
9: 
10: Requirements committed for the 5-day hackathon release. Each requirement is testable and mapped to a roadmap phase.
11: 
12: ### Consent & Privacy
13: 
14: - [x] **CONS-01**: First run displays a full-screen consent modal explaining data handling (photos to AI, audio to ElevenLabs, coarse coords to server, journal stays on device).
15: - [x] **CONS-02**: Consent acceptance stores a timestamped version number in IndexedDB, gating access to all walk and capture features.
16: - [x] **CONS-03**: App requests `navigator.storage.persist()` on consent acceptance and reports persistence status in `/settings`.
17: - [x] **CONS-04**: Permissions (camera, mic, location) are requested just-in-time at point of use with non-blocking inline fallback messaging if denied.
18: 
19: ### Walk Lifecycle & Tracking
20: 
21: - [ ] **WALK-01**: User can start a new walk session from `/walk` with a single tap, generating a unique session in IndexedDB.
22: - [ ] **WALK-02**: Active walk automatically resumes if the browser tab is reloaded, backgrounded, or restored after camera use (`endedAt == null`).
23: - [ ] **WALK-03**: User can end a walk to see a summary card displaying duration, distance, and confirmed species count.
24: - [ ] **GPS-01**: App tracks foreground GPS position, applying noise filtering (reject accuracy > 35m, ignore displacement < 5m unless 15s elapsed).
25: - [ ] **GPS-02**: Capture pins and breadcrumb trail are saved to the active walk record and labeled as "approximate path".
26: - [ ] **MAP-01**: MapLibre GL renders vector map using OpenFreeMap tiles (`liberty` style) centered on the user.
27: - [ ] **MAP-02**: Map displays custom SVG markers for each capture categorized by organism kind.
28: 
29: ### Photo Capture & Processing
30: 
31: - [ ] **CAPT-01**: Large capture button opens the native system camera app via `<input type="file" accept="image/*" capture="environment">`.
32: - [ ] **CAPT-02**: Captured image is decoded to HTML5 Canvas, resized to max edge 1024px, and re-exported as JPEG (quality 0.82) to strip all EXIF/GPS metadata client-side.
33: - [ ] **CAPT-03**: Compressed image blob (~150KB) is saved immediately to Dexie IndexedDB with timestamp and coordinates before any network upload.
34: 
35: ### AI Identification & Verification
36: 
37: - [ ] **IDEN-01**: Client uploads compressed JPEG, month, and coarse region (1 decimal coord) to `/api/identify`.
38: - [ ] **IDEN-02**: Server calls Google AI Studio (Gemma with automatic fallback to Gemini 2.0 Flash) returning up to 3 taxonomic candidates with qualitative confidence (Likely, Possible, Unsure).
39: - [ ] **IDEN-03**: Model identifies non-living objects, blurry captures, or people and returns honest refusal ("Can't tell, try a closer shot").
40: - [ ] **IDEN-04**: Server verifies each candidate against the Wikipedia Action API (`redirects=1`), validating taxon metadata. Taxons that do not resolve are flagged as Unverified.
41: - [ ] **IDEN-05**: User can confirm a candidate or select "None of these" to save as unidentified.
42: 
43: ### Fact Cards & Grounding Safety
44: 
45: - [ ] **FACT-01**: Confirming a candidate triggers `/api/facts` to fetch the plain-text lead section (10–25 sentences) from Wikipedia with numbered sentences.
46: - [ ] **FACT-02**: Gemma synthesizes a short summary (max 40 words) and up to 3 facts (max 20 words each), strictly citing source sentence numbers.
47: - [ ] **FACT-03**: Server validates citations and executes strict regex scrubbing to drop any claims regarding edibility, toxicity, handling, or medicinal use.
48: - [ ] **FACT-04**: If validation drops all facts, server retries once, then falls back to displaying sentence #1 of the verified Wikipedia lead section.
49: - [ ] **FACT-05**: Fact card displays mandatory warning: *"This is a best guess. Don't eat or touch anything based on this app."* and CC BY-SA Wikipedia attribution link.
50: - [ ] **FACT-06**: Fact cards are cached by Wikipedia title to avoid redundant API calls.
51: 
52: ### Voice Notes & Narration
53: 
54: - [ ] **VOIC-01**: User can record up to 60s voice notes using either hold-to-record or tap-to-toggle, complete with a live Web Audio waveform visualization.
55: - [ ] **VOIC-02**: Audio is sent to `/api/transcribe` via ElevenLabs Scribe STT with automatic language detection, saving editable transcripts in IndexedDB.
56: - [ ] **VOIC-03**: If `ELEVENLABS_API_KEY` is missing or fails, app gracefully falls back to browser Web Speech API (`webkitSpeechRecognition`) and manual text notes.
57: - [ ] **SPK-01**: "Listen" button calls `/api/speak` (ElevenLabs TTS with browser `speechSynthesis` fallback) to read fact cards aloud.
58: - [ ] **SPK-02**: Synthesized speech audio is cached in IndexedDB by text hash for zero-cost replay.
59: 
60: ### Routing & Discovery
61: 
62: - [ ] **ROUT-01**: "Suggest a loop" calls `/api/route` (OpenRouteService pedestrian round-trip) for 1km, 2km, or 3km loops.
63: - [ ] **ROUT-02**: If `ORS_API_KEY` is missing or routing fails, UI displays a graceful notice and allows immediate free-form walking without blocking.
64: - [ ] **HUNT-01**: Client generates one daily species hunt challenge deterministically by hashing the local date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) against a rule catalog.
65: - [ ] **HUNT-02**: App tracks daily hunt progress across confirmed finds and triggers a celebration animation upon completion.
66: 
67: ### Collection, Journal & Export
68: 
69: - [ ] **LIFE-01**: `/collection` displays all unique confirmed species grouped by organism kind (Trees, Flowers, Plants, Birds, Insects, Other) with find counts.
70: - [ ] **JOUR-01**: `/journal` displays past walks grouped by date with species counts and an activity heatmap.
71: - [ ] **JOUR-02**: `/journal/[walkId]` shows walk route, track statistics, and find pins.
72: - [ ] **EXPT-01**: User can export their full journal as an Obsidian-compatible ZIP archive containing Markdown walk notes, species cards with CC BY-SA attribution, media JPEGs, and a `treads-backup.json` database dump.
73: - [ ] **SETT-01**: Settings provides "Delete all data" action with confirmation dialog, clearing all IndexedDB tables.
74: 
75: ### Design System, Motion & Sound
76: 
77: - [x] **DSGN-01**: All UI components implement the Tangerin Dream color palette, typography tokens, and border radii using shadcn Base UI.
78: - [x] **DSGN-02**: Motion animations honor `prefers-reduced-motion` with simple opacity fades and pause when the browser tab is hidden.
79: - [ ] **DSGN-03**: Fact card headers and landing tagline feature progressive Tegaki handwriting reveals with web font fallbacks.
80: - [ ] **DSGN-04**: Synthesized Web Audio chimes (Cuelume) provide soft feedback on capture and hunt completion (toggle in `/settings`, off by default).
81: - [ ] **DSGN-05**: Native `navigator.vibrate` haptic pulses trigger on capture and confirmation.
82: 
83: ### Infrastructure & Developer Tools
84: 
85: - [x] **RATE-01**: Server routes enforce IP token bucket rate limiting with in-memory dev mode and Upstash Redis production mode.
86: - [x] **EVAL-01**: Isolated `app/(dev)/eval` developer route executes batch benchmarks on 30 test fixtures, scoring accuracy (≥70%) and refusal rates (≥90%).
87:

92: - **OFFL-01**: Vector tile caching via PMTiles and offline service worker sync queue.
93: - **SYNC-01**: End-to-end encrypted peer-to-peer cloud sync across devices.

14: ## Implementation Decisions
15: 
16: ### Voice Note UI & Attachment Context
17: - **D-01:** Dual recording triggers — Mic button in the `/walk` bottom control dock attaches voice notes to the active walk session (`walkId`), and an "Add voice note" button on `/entry/[id]` attaches field reflections directly to that specific specimen find (`entryId`).
18: - **D-02:** Bottom sheet review drawer — When recording ends and transcription completes, a review bottom sheet displays audio playback controls, detected language badge, and editable transcript textarea with "Save Note" and "Discard" actions.
19: - **D-03:** Map trail audio pins & summary notes reel — Drops a distinct terracotta mic pin at the recording GPS coordinate along the MapLibre trail, and includes a scrollable notes list in the walk completion summary drawer (`walk-summary-sheet.tsx`).
20: - **D-04:** Compressed audio storage in Dexie — Store compressed audio (WebM/Opus) alongside editable transcript text in the Dexie `notes` table, preserving the authentic spoken voice note for replay while keeping IndexedDB storage light (~30-50KB per 60s note). — **Reversibility:** costly — audio compression format and Dexie blob schema require consistent data handling across export and backup modules.
21: 
22: ### Audio Recording Interaction & Waveform
23: - **D-05:** Unified smart gesture — Short tap toggles hands-free recording on/off (tap to start, tap to stop), while continuous press-and-hold records until finger release.
24: - **D-06:** 60-second limit & visual timer — A circular terracotta progress ring fills clockwise around the mic button with a live MM:SS counter, shifts to amber warning color at 50s, and automatically finishes & dispatches to transcription at 60.0s.
25: - **D-07:** Dynamic vertical bar equalizer — Real-time Web Audio `AnalyserNode` frequency bins rendered as 24-32 responsive terracotta bars (`#F35C2B` gradient) with rounded caps, smoothly animated via `requestAnimationFrame`.
26: - **D-08:** Cancellation & mic permissions — Sliding thumb away during hold-to-record aborts without transcribing; tapping a red trash button while hands-free discards the recording. If microphone access is denied, an inline friendly notice explains how to enable permissions in browser settings.
27: 
28: ### TTS Narration & Speech Playback
29: - **D-09:** Full audio card narration — The fact card "Listen" button narrate the organism name intro ("European Robin, Erithacus rubecula"), summary paragraph, and all numbered grounded facts in a seamless storytelling script.

Phase 5: **Collection, Journal & Export**  
Domain: Building the life list collection screen (`/collection`), deterministic daily species hunt gamification (`HUNT-01`, `HUNT-02`), past walk journal timeline with activity heatmap (`/journal`, `/journal/[walkId]`), full Obsidian-compatible ZIP export generator (`EXPT-01`), and IndexedDB data management (`SETT-01`).

We'll clarify **HOW** to implement this phase. (New capabilities outside this scope belong in future phases.)

**Carrying forward from earlier phases:**
- **Design Tokens & Theme:** Tangerin Dream palette (`#F35C2B` primary terracotta, warm dark/light backgrounds), shadcn Base UI primitives, serif typography for field notes.
- **Data Models:** Dexie IndexedDB tables `walks`, `entries`, `notes`, and `settings` with confirmed biological candidates, timestamps, and GPS track points.
- **Local-First Privacy:** All media and journal records stay 100% on-device; export is self-contained client-side ZIP generation via JSZip.
- **Organism Categories:** Standard taxon kinds (`tree`, `flower`, `plant`, `bird`, `insect`, `fungus`, `other`) verified against Wikipedia.

### Summary of Discussion Decisions

1. **Daily Species Hunt (`HUNT-01`, `HUNT-02`):**
   - Tiered multi-target challenge deterministically hashed from `YYYY-MM-DD` (e.g. "Spot 1 Tree and 1 Insect" with progress pips).
   - Automatic day-wide matching: Any confirmed organism identified today (00:00 to 23:59 local time) ticks off matching hunt targets across any walk.
   - Celebration: Evocative celebratory modal dialog with stamp animation, audio chime cue (if enabled), haptic pulse, and dated field badge.
   - Placement: Hero card at the top of `/collection` + compact expandable top HUD pill during `/walk`.

2. **Life List Display & Taxon Grouping (`LIFE-01`):**
   - Navigation: Horizontal scrollable category filter pills with live counts (`All 14`, `Trees 4`, `Birds 3`, etc.) driving a responsive specimen grid.
   - Encounters: Canonical species card with encounter count badge (`Seen 3x`) linking to specimen details, keeping the list de-duplicated.
   - Controls: Real-time text search (common/scientific name) + sort dropdown (`Most Recent`, `Most Seen`, `Alphabetical A–Z`).
   - Empty State: Evocative field notebook empty state with warm serif narrative and a direct `Start a Walk` button.

3. **Journal Timeline & Activity Heatmap (`JOUR-01`, `JOUR-02`):**
   - Heatmap: Rolling multi-week activity grid (GitHub/Obsidian style, 12 weeks, 7 days high) with 4 terracotta intensity levels based on distance and find count.
   - List View: Grouped by date with sticky date headers and rich walk summary cards (duration, distance, specimen thumbnail badges, audio note count).
   - Walk Detail (`/journal/[walkId]`): Split inspection layout with MapLibre header map (route polyline + specimen/audio pins) and tabbed breakdown of Stats, Confirmed Finds, and Voice Notes.
   - Management: Editable walk title + safe delete with confirmation dialog offering choice to preserve confirmed finds in Life List or purge entirely.

4. **Obsidian ZIP Export & Data Management (`EXPT-01`, `SETT-01`):**
   - Vault Structure: Structured Naturalist Vault with `/Walks` (markdown linking to `[[Species/...]]`), `/Species` (taxonomic notes with Wikipedia facts and CC BY-SA attribution), `/Media` (photos & audio), and `treads-backup.json` at root.
   - Frontmatter: Rich Obsidian-native YAML properties with Dataview and Map plugin support (`type`, `date`, `duration`, `distance_meters`, coordinates, `tags: [treads, nature/...]`, wiki-links).
   - Media: Full 1024px JPEGs and recorded WebM audio clips in `/Media` with sanitized slug filenames referenced via `![[...]]` embeds.
   - Settings: Dedicated `/settings` route with storage persistence indicator, audio/haptic toggles, and two-step Danger Zone requiring confirmation to wipe IndexedDB tables.

# Phase 5: Collection, Journal & Export - Context

**Gathered:** 2026-10-08
**Status:** Ready for planning

<domain>
## Phase Boundary

Phase 5 delivers the Life List collection interface (`/collection`), the daily species hunt challenge engine (`HUNT-01`, `HUNT-02`), past expedition history with activity heatmap (`/journal`), walk detail route and telemetry review (`/journal/[walkId]`), full client-side Obsidian-compatible ZIP export generator (`EXPT-01`), and data management / deletion safeguards (`SETT-01`).

</domain>

<decisions>
## Implementation Decisions

### Daily Species Hunt Mechanics & Rules (HUNT-01, HUNT-02)
- **D-01:** Deterministic tiered multi-target challenge — Hashes the local date string (`YYYY-MM-DD`) into a deterministic seed that selects 1–2 target goals from a rules catalog (e.g., "Find 1 Tree and 1 Insect" or "Find 2 distinct Plant varieties") with individual progress pips.
- **D-02:** Day-wide automatic matching — Any confirmed organism identified between 00:00 and 23:59 local time automatically ticks off matching hunt criteria across any walk session without requiring manual check-in or single-session completion.
- **D-03:** Celebratory modal dialog with stamp animation — Fulfilling all targets triggers a celebratory dialog showcasing completed targets, a dated field badge, soft audio chime (if sound enabled), and haptic vibration feedback.
- **D-04:** Dual UI placement — Featured as an evocative hero card at the top of `/collection` and as a compact, expandable top HUD pill during active walks on `/walk`.

### Life List Display & Taxon Grouping (LIFE-01)
- **D-05:** Horizontal category filter pills with live counts — Horizontal scrollable pill bar (`All`, `Trees`, `Flowers`, `Plants`, `Birds`, `Insects`, `Fungus`, `Other`) displaying real-time specimen counts and filtering a responsive grid.
- **D-06:** Canonical species cards with encounter counts — De-duplicates multiple sightings of the same species into a single card featuring the primary photograph, common + scientific name, verified taxon chip, and a `Seen Nx` badge linking to specimen details.
- **D-07:** Real-time search & sorting dropdown — Text input filtering common and scientific names in real time, accompanied by a sort selector (`Most Recent`, `Most Seen`, `Alphabetical A–Z`).
- **D-08:** Evocative field notebook empty state — When no species have been collected or filter returns 0 matches, displays warm serif prose (*"Your field ledger awaits its first discovery..."*), subtle silhouette graphics, and a direct `Start a Walk` button.

### Journal Timeline & Activity Heatmap (JOUR-01, JOUR-02)
- **D-09:** Rolling multi-week activity grid — GitHub/Obsidian style activity matrix (rolling 12 weeks, 7 days high) with 4 terracotta intensity levels based on daily expedition distance and specimen count.
- **D-10:** Date-grouped walk timeline — Grouped chronologically under sticky date headers (`Today`, `Yesterday`, `Oct 4, 2026`) with summary cards showing walk duration, distance, species thumbnail badges, and audio note counts.
- **D-11:** Split inspection layout for `/journal/[walkId]` — Top responsive MapLibre map displaying the full recorded GPS polyline path, specimen pins, and audio pins, followed by section tabs: Walk Stats, Confirmed Finds, and Voice Notes.
- **D-12:** Editable title & safe deletion workflow — Walker can rename past walk sessions or delete an individual walk via a confirmation dialog offering the option to preserve confirmed specimens in the Life List or purge orphaned entries. — **Reversibility:** costly — cascading deletion logic across `walks`, `entries`, and `notes` tables requires strict referential integrity handling in Dexie.

### Obsidian ZIP Export & Settings Data Management (EXPT-01, SETT-01)
- **D-13:** Structured Naturalist Vault architecture — Generates a downloadable ZIP archive using JSZip containing:
  - `/Walks/`: Markdown expedition notes linking via Obsidian `[[Species/...]]` wiki-links.
  - `/Species/`: Taxon notes with Wikipedia facts, CC BY-SA citations, and embedded photos `![[Media/...]]`.
  - `/Media/`: Full 1024px JPEGs and recorded WebM audio clips with sanitized slug filenames.
  - `treads-backup.json`: Complete raw Dexie database JSON dump at vault root for full restore capabilities. — **Reversibility:** costly — export folder structure and markdown wiki-link conventions define external compatibility with Obsidian and user backups.
- **D-14:** Rich Obsidian-native YAML properties — Frontmatter schema compatible with Obsidian Dataview and Map plugins (`type: walk | species`, `date`, `duration`, `distance_meters`, `coordinates`, `tags: [treads, nature/...]`, `encounters`, `wiki_links`).
- **D-15:** Full media bundling with slugified filenames — Exports full-resolution 1024px JPEGs and recorded WebM audio files stored in Dexie, sanitized into readable slugs (e.g. `Media/european-robin-20261008-1422.jpg`).
- **D-16:** Dedicated `/settings` route with Danger Zone gate — Implements `/settings` featuring storage persistence toggle/status (`navigator.storage.persist()`), audio/haptics preferences, instant full export download button, and a red Danger Zone with a type-to-confirm dialog before wiping all Dexie IndexedDB tables.

### the agent's Discretion
- Exact hash algorithm for daily hunt (e.g., MurmurHash3 or simple string DJB2 hash of `YYYY-MM-DD`).
- Heatmap cell size and mobile horizontal touch scrolling behavior.
- Sanitize logic for species filename generation in the ZIP export (replacing special characters and spaces with dashes).

</decisions>

<canonical_refs>
## Canonical References

**Downstream agents MUST read these before planning or implementing.**

### Architecture & Requirements
- `DECISIONS.md` § Decisions 1, 2, 8 — Local-first client architecture, Canvas EXIF stripping, and private IndexedDB storage
- `PRD.md` § 4.6, § 4.7, § 5.3, § 5.5 — Life list collection, journal timeline, export bundle, and Dexie database schema
- `.planning/ROADMAP.md` § Phase 5 — Phase 5 scope, dependencies, requirements (`HUNT-01, HUNT-02, LIFE-01, JOUR-01, JOUR-02, EXPT-01, SETT-01`), and success criteria
- `.planning/REQUIREMENTS.md` § Collection, Journal & Export — Specific acceptance criteria for hunting, life list, heatmap, and ZIP export

### Database & Types
- `lib/db.ts` — Dexie schemas for `Walk`, `Entry`, `Note`, and `UserSettings` tables
- `lib/camera.ts` — Thumbnail and photo blob generation utilities

</canonical_refs>

<code_context>
## Existing Code Insights

### Reusable Assets
- `lib/db.ts`: `db.walks`, `db.entries`, `db.notes`, and `db.settings` tables already populated with data from Phases 1–4.
- `components/ui/card.tsx`, `components/ui/badge.tsx`, `components/ui/button.tsx`, `components/ui/sheet.tsx`, `components/ui/dialog.tsx`: Tangerin Dream styled Base UI components ready for collection, journal, and modal interfaces.
- `components/motion/motion-view.tsx`: Tab-throttled entrance and motion wrapper for smooth page and card transitions.
- `components/map/walk-map.tsx`: MapLibre GL map component with polyline and pin layers, readily adaptable for `/journal/[walkId]` past walk review.
- `components/entry/fact-card.tsx`: Rich fact presentation card with CC BY-SA Wikipedia attribution formatting.
- `components/speech/fact-audio-player.tsx`: Inline audio playback pill for fact cards and note replays.

### Established Patterns
- Client-side data fetching directly from Dexie using `useLiveQuery`.
- Tangerin Dream color palette (`#F35C2B` primary terracotta, muted borders, warm dark and light modes).
- Responsive mobile-first design with bottom sheets and accessible dialog overlays.

### Integration Points
- `app/collection/page.tsx`: New route for Life List species grid, category pills, search/sort, and Daily Hunt hero banner.
- `app/journal/page.tsx`: New route for activity heatmap and chronological walk history.
- `app/journal/[walkId]/page.tsx`: New route for walk route review, telemetry breakdown, and note reel.
- `app/settings/page.tsx`: New route for storage persistence, settings preferences, ZIP export trigger, and data reset.
- `lib/hunt.ts`: Deterministic daily hunt generator hashing `YYYY-MM-DD` to target catalog rules.
- `lib/export.ts`: JSZip archive generator assembling Markdown files, media blobs, and `treads-backup.json`.

</code_context>

<specifics>
## Specific Ideas

- Daily Hunt uses date hash with multi-target criteria (e.g. 1 Tree + 1 Insect) with visual progress pips.
- Celebration dialog displays celebratory stamp animation, haptic pulse, and dated field badge.
- Collection de-duplicates multiple encounters into a single canonical species card showing "Seen Nx" count.
- Activity heatmap renders a 12-week rolling matrix with 4 terracotta intensity levels.
- Obsidian ZIP includes a Naturalist Vault folder structure (`/Walks`, `/Species`, `/Media`, `treads-backup.json`) with Dataview-compatible YAML frontmatter.
- Settings page provides a safe two-step confirmation modal before deleting IndexedDB data.

</specifics>

<deferred>
## Deferred Ideas

- None — discussion stayed strictly within Phase 5 scope.

</deferred>

---

*Phase: 5-Collection, Journal & Export*
*Context gathered: 2026-10-08*

---
phase: 5
slug: collection-journal-export
status: approved
shadcn_initialized: true
preset: none
created: 2026-10-08
---

# Phase 5 — UI Design Contract

> Visual and interaction contract for frontend phases. Generated by gsd-ui-researcher, verified by gsd-ui-checker.

---

## Design System

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Tool | shadcn |
| Preset | not applicable (Tangerin Dream theme tokens) |
| Component library | base-ui (@base-ui-components/react) |
| Icon library | lucide-react |
| Font | Amaranth (sans), Noto Serif (serif), JetBrains Mono (mono) |

---

## Spacing Scale

Declared values (must be multiples of 4):

| Token | Value | Usage |
|-------|-------|-------|
| xs | 4px | Icon gaps, badge padding, progress pip margins |
| sm | 8px | Compact pill padding, card content inner spacing |
| md | 16px | Standard component gap, list item separation |
| lg | 24px | Section padding, modal sheet header padding |
| xl | 32px | Grid separation, drawer spacing |
| 2xl | 48px | Major layout block division |
| 3xl | 64px | Page bottom margin, empty state container margins |

Exceptions: 44px minimum touch target size for mobile HUD icon buttons, category filter pills, and voice playback controls (justified for outdoor mobile accessibility and hit area ergonomics).

---

## Typography

| Role | Size | Weight | Line Height |
|------|------|--------|-------------|
| Body | 16px | 400 (regular) | 1.5 |
| Label | 14px | 600 (semibold) | 1.4 |
| Heading | 20px | 600 (semibold) | 1.2 |
| Display | 28px | 600 (semibold) | 1.2 |

Hierarchy Rules:
- Display (28px semibold) is reserved for page hero headlines ("Life List", "Field Journal", "Expedition Log").
- Heading (20px semibold) is used for section headers, card titles, and modal headers.
- Label (14px semibold) is used for badges, category pills, buttons, and telemetry stat names.
- Body (16px regular) in Noto Serif is used for field observations, Wikipedia excerpts, and descriptive empty states.

---

## Color

| Role | Value | Usage |
|------|-------|-------|
| Dominant (60%) | oklch(0.9592 0.0288 72.4798) / Dark: oklch(0.2376 0.0036 345.5321) | Main screen background, surface canvas, sheet body |
| Secondary (30%) | oklch(0.9772 0.0175 73.0800) / Dark: oklch(0.2763 0.0048 355.0805) | Specimen cards, walk summary cards, header bar, dialog surfaces |
| Accent (10%) | #F35C2B (oklch(0.6559 0.2328 34.5244)) | Primary CTAs, active daily hunt pips, heatmap peak intensity, verified badges |
| Destructive | #DC2626 (oklch(0.6559 0.2328 34.5244)) | Delete Walk Session action, Delete All Data action in Danger Zone |

Accent reserved for:
1. Primary CTA buttons: "Start Walk", "Export Journal ZIP", "Claim Daily Hunt Badge"
2. Daily species hunt progress pips and completion celebratory stamp ring
3. Activity heatmap level-4 peak activity cells (highest distance & species count)
4. Verified taxon badge fill and audio player seek progress bar

---

## Visual Hierarchy & Focal Points

- **/collection Focal Point:** Daily Species Hunt hero card anchored at the top of the viewport with vivid progress pips, followed immediately by the horizontal category filter pill carousel.
- **/journal Focal Point:** Rolling 12-week activity heatmap card showing current streak and total active expeditions, anchoring the top of the chronological timeline.
- **/journal/[walkId] Focal Point:** MapLibre interactive header map displaying the glowing polyline trail and color-coded organism and audio pin drops.
- **/settings Focal Point:** Prominent "Export Journal ZIP" card under Storage & Backups, visually balanced against the bounded red "Danger Zone" card at the page bottom.
- **Accessibility Fallbacks:** All icon-only buttons (such as search clear button, audio note play button, and navigation arrows) provide visually hidden `aria-label` text.

---

## Copywriting Contract

| Element | Copy |
|---------|------|
| Primary CTA (Collection) | "Start Walk" |
| Primary CTA (Settings Export) | "Export Journal ZIP" |
| Primary CTA (Daily Hunt) | "Claim Daily Hunt Badge" |
| Primary CTA (Walk Detail) | "Inspect Specimen" |
| Empty state heading (Collection) | "Your field ledger awaits its first discovery" |
| Empty state body (Collection) | "Explore outdoors and record your first confirmed organism find to start your permanent life list." |
| Empty state heading (Journal) | "No expeditions recorded yet" |
| Empty state body (Journal) | "Every journey begins with a single step. Start a walk to record GPS tracks, species finds, and audio notes." |
| Search empty state heading | "No matching species found" |
| Search empty state body | "Try a different search term or select another category filter to find your specimens." |
| Error state (Dexie Read) | "Unable to load field journal records. Refresh your browser or check local storage permissions." |
| Error state (Export Generation) | "Failed to assemble Obsidian ZIP archive. Ensure sufficient free disk space and retry export." |
| Destructive confirmation (Delete Walk) | "Delete Walk Session: Remove this walk from your journal? You can choose to preserve confirmed specimens in your Life List or purge all associated entries." |
| Destructive confirmation (Delete All Data) | "Delete All Data: Permanently delete all field walks, confirmed species entries, voice recordings, and cached speech? This cannot be undone. Type DELETE to confirm." |

---

## UI Considerations

> Populated by the ui-phase UI-consideration probe (Step 9.5) and lifted by plan-phase's
> `## UI Considerations` lift rule via the identical rule as SPEC `## Edge Coverage`. Shape-rooted UI *state*
> coverage (empty / loading / error / populated / partial / overflow / zero-one-many / long-text).
> Empty-state and error-state COPY live in `## Copywriting Contract` above — this section covers
> state coverage and REFERENCES those rows rather than restating the copy (de-dup).

Applicable state considerations resolved: 29 covered, 0 backstop, 0 unresolved

| Category | Element(s) | Status | Resolution / Reason |
|----------|------------|--------|---------------------|
| empty | E1 (Life List) | ✅ covered | Empty collection renders "Your field ledger awaits its first discovery" with "Start Walk" CTA button |
| loading | E1 (Life List) | ✅ covered | Initial Dexie query displays 6 skeleton card placeholders matching specimen card dimensions |
| error | E1 (Life List) | ✅ covered | IndexedDB read error displays "Unable to load field journal records" with "Retry" action |
| populated | E1 (Life List) | ✅ covered | Standard responsive 2-column grid of canonical species cards with "Seen Nx" count badges |
| partial | E1 (Life List) | ✅ covered | Filter selection with 0 results renders "No matching species found" with clear filter link |
| overflow | E1 (Life List) | ✅ covered | Horizontal category filter pills container uses touch scroll with hidden scrollbars |
| zero-one-many | E1 (Life List) | ✅ covered | Category chips show exact counts: "All (14)", "Birds (1)", "Trees (0)" with disabled state for 0 |
| long-text | E1 (Life List) | ✅ covered | Long binomial scientific names truncate with ellipsis on mobile viewports while common name wraps to 2 lines max |
| empty | E2 (Daily Hunt) | ✅ covered | Before any find today, renders unfulfilled outline progress pips with target labels |
| loading | E2 (Daily Hunt) | ✅ covered | Deterministic date-hash resolution runs synchronously on mount; renders subtle shimmer pill if delayed |
| error | E2 (Daily Hunt) | ✅ covered | Deterministic rule generation fallbacks to "Find any 2 species today" if date-hash catalog fails |
| populated | E2 (Daily Hunt) | ✅ covered | Shows target cards with filled progress pips, remaining goal count, and local date badge |
| partial | E2 (Daily Hunt) | ✅ covered | Partially completed goals show glowing terracotta pips for completed criteria and amber for in-progress |
| overflow | E2 (Daily Hunt) | ✅ covered | Multi-target items wrap gracefully into a 2-column mini-card grid within the hero banner |
| zero-one-many | E2 (Daily Hunt) | ✅ covered | Pips render exactly 1 or 2 discrete target circles based on daily challenge difficulty |
| empty | E3 (Journal) | ✅ covered | Zero walks recorded renders "No expeditions recorded yet" with "Start Walk" button |
| loading | E3 (Journal) | ✅ covered | Heatmap grid displays 12 columns of muted grey placeholder cells before Dexie resolves |
| error | E3 (Journal) | ✅ covered | Dexie error shows inline alert banner above timeline with refresh prompt |
| populated | E3 (Journal) | ✅ covered | Chronological date-grouped cards with distance, duration, species thumbnails, and audio note counts |
| partial | E3 (Journal) | ✅ covered | Incomplete walks (ended abruptly) show "Unfinished expedition" status chip and recorded duration |
| overflow | E3 (Journal) | ✅ covered | 12-week heatmap allows horizontal swipe/scroll on viewports narrower than 640px |
| zero-one-many | E3 (Journal) | ✅ covered | Walk cards adapt layout when 0 species found vs 1 species vs many species thumbnail reel |
| loading | E4 (Walk Detail) | ✅ covered | MapLibre map renders placeholder blurred terrain while vector tiles load |
| error | E4 (Walk Detail) | ✅ covered | Non-existent walkId in URL redirects to /journal with toast notice "Expedition not found" |
| overflow | E4 (Walk Detail) | ✅ covered | Map fits bounding box of walk track points with 24px padding; tabs scroll horizontally on narrow screens |
| long-text | E4 (Walk Detail) | ✅ covered | Long custom walk titles wrap cleanly up to 3 lines before header controls |
| loading | E5 (Settings) | ✅ covered | Storage persistence status queries navigator.storage and displays live status badge |
| error | E5 (Settings) | ✅ covered | Export failure displays error modal with reason and retry button |
| long-text | E5 (Settings) | ✅ covered | Setting descriptions wrap comfortably at body size without clipping |

---

## Registry Safety

| Registry | Blocks Used | Safety Gate |
|----------|-------------|-------------|
| shadcn official | none (using project-installed Base UI primitives) | not required |

---

## Checker Sign-Off

- [x] Dimension 1 Copywriting: PASS
- [x] Dimension 2 Visuals: PASS
- [x] Dimension 3 Color: PASS
- [x] Dimension 4 Typography: PASS
- [x] Dimension 5 Spacing: PASS
- [x] Dimension 6 Registry Safety: PASS

# Phase 5: Collection, Journal & Export - Technical Research

**Phase:** 05  
**Domain:** Life List Collection, Daily Species Hunt Rules, Activity Heatmap Timeline, Obsidian-Compatible ZIP Export & IndexedDB Reset  
**Status:** Completed  
**Confidence:** HIGH  

---

## User Constraints

*(Verbatim from `.planning/phases/05-collection-journal-export/05-CONTEXT.md`)*

### Daily Species Hunt Mechanics & Rules (HUNT-01, HUNT-02)
- **D-01:** Deterministic tiered multi-target challenge — Hashes the local date string (`YYYY-MM-DD`) into a deterministic seed that selects 1–2 target goals from a rules catalog (e.g., "Find 1 Tree and 1 Insect" or "Find 2 distinct Plant varieties") with individual progress pips.
- **D-02:** Day-wide automatic matching — Any confirmed organism identified between 00:00 and 23:59 local time automatically ticks off matching hunt criteria across any walk session without requiring manual check-in or single-session completion.
- **D-03:** Celebratory modal dialog with stamp animation — Fulfilling all targets triggers a celebratory dialog showcasing completed targets, a dated field badge, soft audio chime (if sound enabled), and haptic vibration feedback.
- **D-04:** Dual UI placement — Featured as an evocative hero card at the top of `/collection` and as a compact, expandable top HUD pill during active walks on `/walk`.

### Life List Display & Taxon Grouping (LIFE-01)
- **D-05:** Horizontal category filter pills with live counts — Horizontal scrollable pill bar (`All`, `Trees`, `Flowers`, `Plants`, `Birds`, `Insects`, `Fungus`, `Other`) displaying real-time specimen counts and filtering a responsive grid.
- **D-06:** Canonical species cards with encounter counts — De-duplicates multiple sightings of the same species into a single card featuring the primary photograph, common + scientific name, verified taxon chip, and a `Seen Nx` badge linking to specimen details.
- **D-07:** Real-time search & sorting dropdown — Text input filtering common and scientific names in real time, accompanied by a sort selector (`Most Recent`, `Most Seen`, `Alphabetical A–Z`).
- **D-08:** Evocative field notebook empty state — When no species have been collected or filter returns 0 matches, displays warm serif prose (*"Your field ledger awaits its first discovery..."*), subtle silhouette graphics, and a direct `Start a Walk` button.

### Journal Timeline & Activity Heatmap (JOUR-01, JOUR-02)
- **D-09:** Rolling multi-week activity grid — GitHub/Obsidian style activity matrix (rolling 12 weeks, 7 days high) with 4 terracotta intensity levels based on daily expedition distance and specimen count.
- **D-10:** Date-grouped walk timeline — Grouped chronologically under sticky date headers (`Today`, `Yesterday`, `Oct 4, 2026`) with summary cards showing walk duration, distance, species thumbnail badges, and audio note counts.
- **D-11:** Split inspection layout for `/journal/[walkId]` — Top responsive MapLibre map displaying the full recorded GPS polyline path, specimen pins, and audio pins, followed by section tabs: Walk Stats, Confirmed Finds, and Voice Notes.
- **D-12:** Editable title & safe deletion workflow — Walker can rename past walk sessions or delete an individual walk via a confirmation dialog offering the option to preserve confirmed specimens in the Life List or purge orphaned entries.

### Obsidian ZIP Export & Settings Data Management (EXPT-01, SETT-01)
- **D-13:** Structured Naturalist Vault architecture — Generates a downloadable ZIP archive using JSZip containing:
  - `/Walks/`: Markdown expedition notes linking via Obsidian `[[Species/...]]` wiki-links.
  - `/Species/`: Taxon notes with Wikipedia facts, CC BY-SA citations, and embedded photos `![[Media/...]]`.
  - `/Media/`: Full 1024px JPEGs and recorded WebM audio clips with sanitized slug filenames.
  - `treads-backup.json`: Complete raw Dexie database JSON dump at vault root for full restore capabilities.
- **D-14:** Rich Obsidian-native YAML properties — Frontmatter schema compatible with Obsidian Dataview and Map plugins (`type: walk | species`, `date`, `duration`, `distance_meters`, `coordinates`, `tags: [treads, nature/...]`, `encounters`, `wiki_links`).
- **D-15:** Full media bundling with slugified filenames — Exports full-resolution 1024px JPEGs and recorded WebM audio files stored in Dexie, sanitized into readable slugs (e.g. `Media/european-robin-20261008-1422.jpg`).
- **D-16:** Dedicated `/settings` route with Danger Zone gate — Implements `/settings` featuring storage persistence toggle/status (`navigator.storage.persist()`), audio/haptics preferences, instant full export download button, and a red Danger Zone with a type-to-confirm dialog before wiping all Dexie IndexedDB tables.

---

## Phase Requirements

| ID | Description | Technical Requirement |
|----|-------------|-----------------------|
| `HUNT-01` | Deterministic daily species challenge from local date hash (`YYYY-MM-DD`) | Hash generator in `lib/hunt.ts` maps day string to goal combination |
| `HUNT-02` | Progress tracking across confirmed finds with completion celebration | Live query matching entries created today (`createdAt >= startOfDay`), stamp animation trigger |
| `LIFE-01` | `/collection` displays all unique confirmed finds grouped by organism kind | Aggregation query reducing entries by canonical `wikipediaTitle` / `scientificName`, taxon pills |
| `JOUR-01` | `/journal` displays past walks grouped by date with heatmap | 12-week matrix grouping walks by calendar day with 4-level terracotta scale |
| `JOUR-02` | `/journal/[walkId]` shows walk route, telemetry stats, and find pins | MapLibre route polyline layer, find markers, audio pins, stats tab, and safe delete |
| `EXPT-01` | Obsidian-compatible ZIP export generator | Client-side JSZip packaging of `/Walks`, `/Species`, `/Media`, and `treads-backup.json` |
| `SETT-01` | Settings data wipe action with confirmation dialog | Reset Dexie tables (`walks.clear()`, `entries.clear()`, `notes.clear()`, `speechCache.clear()`) |

---

## Standard Stack

1. **ZIP Packaging:** `jszip` (v3.10.1) [VERIFIED: npm registry]
   - Generates browser-side downloadable ZIP blobs without server roundtrips.
   - Handles binary blobs (`Blob`, `Uint8Array`) seamlessly for photos and WebM audio.
2. **Database Engine:** `dexie` (4.4.6) and `dexie-react-hooks` (4.4.0) [VERIFIED: package.json:21-22]
   - `useLiveQuery` delivers zero-latency reactive updates across collection, journal, and walk HUD.
3. **Component Primitives:** `@base-ui-components/react` (1.0.0-rc.0) and `components/ui/` [VERIFIED: package.json:13]
   - Dialog, Sheet, Button, Card, Badge, Progress with Tangerin Dream theme tokens.
4. **Map Rendering:** `maplibre-gl` (6.13.0) [VERIFIED: package.json:24]
   - Reused on `/journal/[walkId]` using existing OpenFreeMap vector style.
5. **Icons:** `lucide-react` (1.52.0) [VERIFIED: package.json:23]
   - Category icons (`TreePine`, `Flower2`, `Sprout`, `Bird`, `Bug`, `Sparkles`, `Footprints`, `Download`, `Trash2`).

---

## Architecture Patterns

### 1. Deterministic Daily Hunt Rule Engine (`lib/hunt.ts`)
A lightweight, zero-dependency hash function (FNV-1a 32-bit) converts local `YYYY-MM-DD` (e.g., `"2026-10-08"`) into an integer seed:
```ts
function hashDateString(dateStr: string): number {
  let hash = 2166136261;
  for (let i = 0; i < dateStr.length; i++) {
    hash ^= dateStr.charCodeAt(i);
    hash = Math.imul(hash, 16777619);
  }
  return hash >>> 0;
}
```
The seed indexes into a curated catalog of challenges:
- Tier 1: Single kind pairs (e.g. 1 Tree + 1 Flower, 1 Bird + 1 Plant, 1 Insect + 1 Tree)
- Tier 2: Quantity focus (e.g. 2 distinct Plants, 2 distinct Trees)
- Tier 3: Explorer challenge (e.g. 1 Animal/Bird/Insect + 1 Flora/Tree/Plant)

Each challenge has:
- `id`: Unique string
- `date`: `YYYY-MM-DD`
- `targets`: `Array<{ kind: OrganismKind; count: number; label: string }>`
- `title`: Short descriptive title (e.g., "Canopy & Micro-Fauna")
- `description`: Narrative prompt

### 2. Life List De-duplication Aggregation
In Dexie, `db.entries` contains all individual sightings. To produce the canonical Life List:
```ts
const confirmedEntries = await db.entries.where('status').equals('confirmed').toArray();
const canonicalMap = new Map<string, {
  canonicalEntry: Entry;
  encounters: number;
  dates: number[];
  walkIds: string[];
}>();

for (const entry of confirmedEntries) {
  const key = entry.confirmed?.wikipediaTitle || entry.confirmed?.scientificName || entry.id;
  if (!canonicalMap.has(key)) {
    canonicalMap.set(key, { canonicalEntry: entry, encounters: 1, dates: [entry.createdAt], walkIds: [entry.walkId] });
  } else {
    const item = canonicalMap.get(key)!;
    item.encounters += 1;
    item.dates.push(entry.createdAt);
    if (!item.walkIds.includes(entry.walkId)) item.walkIds.push(entry.walkId);
  }
}
```

### 3. Activity Heatmap Grid Generator
Generates a matrix of 12 rolling weeks ending today.
Each cell represents one day `YYYY-MM-DD` with:
- `walkCount`: number of completed walks
- `distanceMeters`: sum of walk distances
- `speciesCount`: unique species found that day
- `intensity`: 0 (none), 1 (light), 2 (moderate), 3 (high), 4 (peak)
Mapped to Tangerin Dream terracotta intensity classes (`bg-muted/40`, `bg-[#F35C2B]/25`, `bg-[#F35C2B]/50`, `bg-[#F35C2B]/75`, `bg-[#F35C2B]`).

### 4. Obsidian Naturalist Vault Structure (`lib/export.ts`)
The JSZip generator produces:
```
Treads-Journal-YYYY-MM-DD/
├── Walks/
│   ├── 2026-10-08-afternoon-loop.md
│   └── 2026-10-07-riverside-trail.md
├── Species/
│   ├── European-Robin.md
│   └── English-Oak.md
├── Media/
│   ├── european-robin-20261008-1422.jpg
│   ├── voice-note-walk-20261008-1430.webm
│   └── english-oak-20261008-1435.jpg
└── treads-backup.json
```

**Walk Note Frontmatter & Markdown:**
```markdown
---

# European Robin (*Erithacus rubecula*)

![[Media/european-robin-20261008-1422.jpg]]

## Field Facts
> The European robin is a small insectivorous passerine bird known for its distinctive orange breast.

- [1] The robin is found across Europe, east to Western Siberia and south to North Africa.
- [2] Males and females have identical plumage.

*Source: Wikipedia (CC BY-SA 4.0)*
```

---

## Don't Hand-Roll

1. **Don't hand-roll ZIP packaging:** Use `jszip` — it handles UTF-8 file paths, binary stream conversion, and Deflate compression reliably.
2. **Don't hand-roll Blob download anchors:** Create an object URL from `zip.generateAsync({ type: 'blob' })` and invoke temporary `<a download="filename.zip">.click()`, followed by `URL.revokeObjectURL(url)`.
3. **Don't hand-roll date-math timezones:** Work with local ISO strings `new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-CA')` (returns `YYYY-MM-DD` reliably across locales in modern browsers) so midnight rollovers strictly match the user's phone clock.
4. **Don't hand-roll IndexedDB transaction cascades:** Use Dexie's atomic `db.transaction('rw', [db.walks, db.entries, db.notes], async () => { ... })` for walk deletion and data wipe.

---

## Common Pitfalls

1. **Blob memory leakage during ZIP export:** Storing all photos and audio in memory simultaneously before zipping can exceed memory limits if a user has hundreds of photos.
   *Mitigation:* Iterate entries sequentially, loading Blob from Dexie, appending to JSZip, and releasing references.
2. **Image Blob format in Dexie:** Dexie stores photos either as native `Blob` objects or string URLs. Ensure `export.ts` checks `typeof photo === 'string'` (e.g. data URL or object URL) vs `instanceof Blob` and safely extracts binary ArrayBuffers.
3. **Invalid filename characters in Obsidian Wiki-links:** Obsidian file paths cannot contain `: / \ ? * < > " |`.
   *Mitigation:* Sanitize species titles: `title.replace(/[/\\?%*:|"<>]/g, '-').trim()`.
4. **Referential integrity when deleting a walk:** When a user deletes a walk session, removing `walkId` from `entries` would orphan them unless handled.
   *Mitigation:* D-12 provides the choice: preserve confirmed finds by setting `walkId: 'independent'` or purge associated entries.

---

## Validation Architecture

Nyquist validation plan for Phase 5 verification:

1. **Unit / Pure Logic Verification:**
   - Deterministic Hunt Generator (`lib/hunt.ts`): Verify that calling `getDailyHunt('2026-10-08')` produces identical targets across repeated invocations.
   - ZIP Export Structure (`lib/export.ts`): Verify that generated ZIP contains required root files (`treads-backup.json`), `/Walks/`, `/Species/`, and `/Media/`.
2. **Dexie Reactive Queries:**
   - Verify `useLiveQuery` reflects confirmed find count updates in `/collection` without requiring manual page reload.
   - Verify `useLiveQuery` reflects completed walk additions in `/journal`.
3. **Safety Gate Verification:**
   - Verify `/settings` "Delete All Data" requires typing "DELETE" and completely empties all Dexie tables.
4. **Obsidian Import Verification:**
   - Inspect markdown output for valid YAML frontmatter delimiters (`---`), proper wiki-link formatting (`[[...]]`), and embedded media syntax (`![[...]]`).

# Plan 05-01: Daily Species Hunt Engine, Celebration Dialog & Life List Collection

## Objective
Build the gamified nature discovery engine and permanent naturalist collection: implement the deterministic daily species hunt rules generator (`HUNT-01`), automated day-wide progress matching with celebration modal dialog (`HUNT-02`), and the responsive Life List collection screen (`LIFE-01`) on `/collection` featuring category pills, search/sort, canonical de-duplicated specimen cards, and field notebook empty states.

  - **D-07:** Real-time text search and sort dropdown (`Most Recent`, `Most Seen`, `Alphabetical A–Z`).
  - **D-08:** Evocative field notebook empty state with warm serif prose and `Start Walk` button.

# Plan 05-02: Activity Heatmap, Walk Detail Replay, Obsidian ZIP Exporter & Settings Data Management

## Objective
Deliver complete historical expedition exploration and data sovereignty: build the `/journal` timeline with rolling 12-week activity heatmap (`JOUR-01`), the `/journal/[walkId]` inspection page with MapLibre route replay and safe deletion (`JOUR-02`), the full Obsidian-compatible JSZip archive exporter (`EXPT-01`), and the dedicated `/settings` page with two-step Danger Zone data wipe (`SETT-01`).

## User Rules & Context
- **SHELL:** zsh
- **Package Manager:** pnpm
- **Dependencies:** Install `jszip` and `@types/jszip` using `pnpm add jszip && pnpm add -D @types/jszip`.
- **Design Contract:** Follow Tangerin Dream tokens, 4-multiple spacing scale, 4 font sizes, and reserved accent usage in `05-UI-SPEC.md`.
- **Locked Decisions (per CONTEXT.md):**
  - **D-09:** Rolling multi-week activity grid (12 weeks, 7 days high) with 4 terracotta intensity levels based on mileage and find count.
  - **D-10:** Chronological date-grouped walk timeline with rich summary cards.
  - **D-11:** Split inspection layout for `/journal/[walkId]` with MapLibre header map (route polyline + specimen/audio pins) and tabbed details.
  - **D-12:** Editable walk title and safe delete confirmation prompt offering to preserve confirmed finds in Life List or purge entirely.
  - **D-13:** Structured Naturalist Vault ZIP archive with `/Walks`, `/Species`, `/Media`, and `treads-backup.json` at root.
  - **D-14:** Rich Obsidian-native YAML properties with Dataview and Map plugin compatibility.
  - **D-15:** Full 1024px JPEGs and recorded WebM audio clips in `/Media` with sanitized slug filenames referenced via `![[...]]`.
  - **D-16:** Dedicated `/settings` route with storage persistence status, audio/haptic preferences, instant export download, and a two-step Danger Zone modal for IndexedDB reset.

       - Implement YAML frontmatter serializer for species (`type: species`, `common_name`, `scientific_name`, `kind`, `verified`, `wikipedia`, `first_seen`, `encounters`, `tags: [treads, nature/...]`).
       - Implement filename sanitizer: `sanitizeFilename(name: string): string` stripping illegal characters (`: / \ ? * < > " |`) and formatting lowercase kebab slugs.
       - Implement `generateObsidianVaultZip(onProgress?: (percent: number, step: string) => void): Promise<Blob>`:
         - Initializes `new JSZip()`.
         - Reads `db.walks`, `db.entries`, `db.notes`, and `db.settings`.
